verdict.rationale: Openness of design source is a fair question for a processor, since open hardware designs exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Qualcomm publishing the Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme's own source or design under an open license. The only open-source mention is the GenieX toolkit on AI Hub, which is a separate software tool, not the product's source, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
